A massive Highway Interchange is taking shape near Abhanpur in Raipur district, Chhattisgarh! In this video, we bring you an extensive drone and ground-level construction update of this important highway junction, where three major highway routes are being connected.
The Abhanpur Mega Highway Interchange will connect *NH-30 (Raipur–Jagdalpur Highway), Durg–Raipur–Arang Highway, and NH-130CD (Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor).* This junction is an important part of the developing highway network in Chhattisgarh.
